I’ve never stayed at Circus Circus , but I’ve loved it from the minute I walked underneath the oversized chandelier hanging from the glowing porte cochere. Nostalgia oozes from every corner of the ultrakitschy casino at the north end of the Las Vegas Strip, including enormous neon clown signs ripped from a bygone era of Vegas . I love it for the same maximalist reason I love the Madonna Inn and the Cabazon dinosaurs : If you look hard enough, you can really get a sense of what it was like in its glory days. As an unapologetic theme park person , I’d had Circus Circus’ Adventuredome on my list for a long time. The indoor amusement park, under a gleaming pink dome behind the main casino and hotel tower, is an anomaly in Las Vegas . Yes, the city has other thrill rides like the Big Apple Coaster at New York-New York, but none of them requires you to walk through a midway with trapeze artists swinging overhead to get there. items.text: India formally names 28 places and features in Ladakh on official map amid China push | Why it matters
items.article: India has formally named and mapped 28 places and geographical features in Ladakh on official Survey of India maps, following a similar exercise in Arunachal Pradesh. The move comes amid China’s practice of assigning Chinese names to locations in Indian territories. The Centre has formally identified and mapped 28 places and geographical features in Ladakh on the official Survey of India map, the Ministry of Home Affairs (MHA) said on Friday. The MHA said the exercise was carried out in consultation with the Union Territory administration and is aimed at facilitating the “accurate recognition” of these locations and improving public awareness about them. The move comes after the Centre standardised the names of 27 places and geographical features in Arunachal Pradesh in August this year. The newly standardised names include Zorawar Peak, Kanishka Peak, Atisha Giri, Martand Giri, Rinchen Zangpo, Sakyasri Giri, Marpa Lotsava Ri, Milarepa Kangri, Shiva Ri and Maheshvara Ri. The list also includes Karun Pir, Drak Karpo and Jolmori mountains; Chapchingal Pass and Shachmirk Pass; Parpik and Skamri glaciers; and Shkorga Valley. Other identified geographical features include Brangsa, Kuksel, Dehra Compass, Gogra, Kumarayana Point, Panglung and Shamal Lungpa.

items.text: Government gives 'younger age' update over pensions for emergency service workers
items.article: It follows calls to change the pension age for frontline workers The Government has issued a pensions update for members of the emergency services. A Government statement confirmed that it had 'no plans' to bring the pension age down for ambulance service workers . Currently, 60 is the standard normal pension age for members of the police and fire service, assuming it is a full pension paid without reductions. A petition submitted to the Government called for this same age limit to be introduced for ambulance workers. Such a petition can be launched by any British citizen or UK resident, and the Government must respond once it has 10,000 signatures, while it must be considered for debate in Parliament once it has 100,000. This petition, launched by Barbara Elizabeth Whitehead, has 19,755 signatures at the time of writing, having hit 10,000 on September 9. The petition says: "Lower the pension age for ambulance service workers under the NHS scheme to 60, in line with the Police and Firefighters. Ambulance staff have the stresses and face the same dangers as police and fire fighters. They do not have the privilege of lower pension ages despite being front line workers. "We believe it is the duty of Parliamentarians to bring ALL emergency service staff in line regarding pensions and pay more widely.
